title: Azure SQL Backup & Point-in-Time Recovery
domain: AZURE SQL / PITR / GEO BACKUP / PRIVATE ACCESS
subtitle: Keep the native backup policy explicit and prepare recovery without risking the source.
scenario: A workforce application needs recovery from data mistakes and regional backup loss while preserving private SQL access and the keys/files its records depend on.
outcome: Make production retention and redundancy inspectable, separate backup policy from restore acceptance and reject unsafe rehearsal targets.
flow: Inspect exact source and backup window
Review isolated target access, cost and expiry
Validate a fictional restore request locally
Keep the actual Azure restore explicitly pending
notes: The Terraform SQL module is actual implementation source with neutral identifiers.
The readiness checker is newly authored portfolio reference code derived from the prepared procedure, not deployed restore automation.
All green checks use fictional metadata. They do not establish current backup availability, private connectivity or a completed SQL restore.
boundary: Actual SQL infrastructure source plus fictional local readiness checks. No Azure query, restore, database copy or application cutover.
